blocks.text: Ice Castle Rentals - Detroit Lakes, MN

Experience the best ice fishing Detroit Lakes MN has to offer with Baxstar’s luxury Ice Castle sleeper house rentals. Stay warm, comfortable, and right on the fish—all backed by 30+ years of local fishing expertise.
Luxury Ice Fishing House Rentals in Detroit Lakes

Baxstar Fishing offers clean, comfortable, professionally maintained Ice Castle sleeper houses designed for an easy, enjoyable, and warm ice fishing experience. Whether you’re planning a weekend getaway, multi-day fishing trip, or family adventure, our houses are equipped to keep you comfortable and on the fish.
17' Ice Castle Sleeper

We offer three 17’ Ice Castle sleeper houses, each with a slightly different layout, bed configuration, and model-year updates. All three include the same standard Baxstar amenities, heating, comfort, and fishing features.  Some offer bed, fireplace, generator, and other upgrades.


 


You’ll be able to compare all three models, view photos, see specifics, and choose the one that fits your group best.​​


​


Each 17’ model includes an efficient layout perfect for couples, small groups, and quick weekend trips.​

21'-24' Ice Castle Sleepers (Biggest)

Our most spacious sleeper houses, perfect for larger groups, bachelor trips, or multi-day adventures. The 21’-24' models provides additional seating, storage, and room to move around—ideal for groups of 5–7 who want extra comfort and space.​​

Rental Details

A $500 damage deposit required to book an Ice Castle

 

 
 Must have a 4 x 4 vehicle and be comfortable driving on the ice

 

 
 Bookable online up to 7 days (contact us for longer rentals)

 

 
 No smoking in units

 

 
 Pets are allowed, and subject to damage deposit

 

 
 No running water (standard for Ice Castles)​
